concept: The driver says Fenwick Road is closed. The viewer chooses: stay on, or get off at the next stop. A split screen plays both. They converge on one shelter, where a frost-covered Ivy has been waiting a long time: 'Took you long enough.'

hooks.line: The driver says your stop is closed. What now?
hooks.first_visual: Night bus interior; the destination display flickers; Ivy's reflection in the black window.

hooks.line: Stay on, or get off at the next stop?
hooks.first_visual: Split screen: a bus aisle and an open door into fog.

hooks.line: Both choices ended at the same shelter.
hooks.first_visual: Two paths converging on one bus shelter.

hooks.line: 'Took you long enough,' she said. In my voice.
hooks.first_visual: A frosted woman on a shelter bench looking up.

hooks.line: Fenwick Road. Closed tonight. Every night.

setting: Night bus No. 9; a fog-bound shelter on the Fenwick route.
conflict: Ivy has to choose how to get home.
escalation: Both paths look normal, then wrong: empty stops, fog.
reveal: Both outcomes reach the same shelter and the same waiting Ivy.
